column1: # Platform controller ids capsule_acpi publishes to the broker (MAPD) when a
# present and enabled device names one as its _HID or a _CID and its _CRS
# gives a memory window. Columns, tab-separated: the id, its class (i2c, sd,
# gpio), and where the id is documented. "unverified" means no published
# document was read in writing the line: the id is recalled. A wrong one
# publishes a controller under the wrong class; the kernel's region rule
# still holds its windows to device memory no other device sits in.
